misc-van-01-c1.text: National Park Service, Fort Raleigh National Historic Site. 1590 Rescue Voyage. nps.gov.
misc-van-01-c1.quote: Landing on August 18, 1590, White and his men found remnants of the colonists but no signs of life.
misc-van-01-c1.claim: When White finally got back to Roanoke in August 1590, the colony was empty.

misc-van-01-c1.text: National Park Service, Fort Raleigh National Historic Site. 1590 Rescue Voyage. nps.gov.
misc-van-01-c1.quote: There were no signs of a struggle or of the colonists leaving in haste.
misc-van-01-c1.claim: and there weren't any signs of struggle

misc-van-01-c2.text: National Park Service, Fort Raleigh National Historic Site. 1590 Rescue Voyage. nps.gov.
misc-van-01-c2.quote: as had happened so often before, a storm disrupted his plans and he was forced to return to England
misc-van-01-c2.claim: White wanted to investigate, but a storm forced his ship back to England before he could land at Hatteras.
